round: Round 16 (Daily 2026-11-27): Today Direct Cancel, Async Cancel Dialog Lock via useModalDialog, and Low-Ticket Student Filter
reviewer: Independent subagent deep-reviewer (conversation 8dd6b6ac-4f71-455b-af6f-9ac5f198f07f) + live public deployment & visual browser verification

resolvedFindings: Finding #1 (High): Added cancelError state (role=alert) and try/catch/finally so cancel confirmation dialog stays open on rejection and closes only on success without unhandled rejections.

Finding #2 (High): Unified both cancel confirmation dialogs onto useModalDialog (role=dialog, aria-modal=true, isDismissDisabled=cancelPending, initialFocusRef=cancelBackButtonRef), eliminating Blink CloseWatcher double-Escape desync and guaranteeing body.style.overflow lock/restore.

Finding #3 (High): Added openCancelDialog mutual exclusion between completeRide and cancelRide, mountedRef guard in completeRide, stale cancelRideId cleanup effect, and clear on parent student switch.
Finding #4 (Medium): Added #main-content focus fallback in useModalDialog.ts when previousActiveElement is disconnected after ride cancellation.
Finding #5 (Medium) & Low notes: Expanded test_dashboard_cancel_and_filter.cjs (5/5 PASS + JSON evidence), added border-rose-300, [overflow-wrap:anywhere] on ride.note, and studentName fallback.
nonBlockingNotes: NB-01: Adding cancelPending to the stale cancelRideId cleanup dependency array would further harden hypothetical future callers that mutate rides before rejecting.
